boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Furman University
boards.description: Ten currently verified Greenville food destinations with late drive-thru or 24-hour availability; all are under-21-safe and require a purchase.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Pelham Road
cards.subtitle: 3709 Pelham Road, Greenville, SC 29615
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when a late food stop fits your plans. Confirm the day’s hours before leaving, since dining-room hours end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Greenville Taco Bell with drive-thru service listed into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Greenville location’s drive-thru as open until 2 a.m. most nights and until 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3709 Pelham Road, Greenville
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru 8 a.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday; 8 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on W Blueridge Drive
cards.subtitle: 3409 W Blueridge Dr, Greenville, SC 29611
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service rather than a late dine-in visit. Check the restaurant’s live listing before travel, particularly on holidays.
cards.short_summary: A Greenville drive-thru option whose listed hours extend to 2 or 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this location’s drive-thru as open until 2 a.m. daily and until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3409 W Blueridge Dr, Greenville
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru 8 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on N Pleasantburg Drive
cards.subtitle: 3207 N Pleasantburg Dr, Greenville, SC 29609
cards.notes: This is a drive-thru stop for a late return toward campus. Verify the day’s schedule in the official locator before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A N Pleasantburg drive-thru listed until 1 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this location’s drive-thru as open until 1 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 3207 N Pleasantburg Dr, Greenville
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru 8 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Wade Hampton Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2031 Wade Hampton Blvd, Greenville, SC 29615
cards.notes: Keep this as a drive-thru-only late option; the posted dining room closes earlier. Recheck the official hours if your timing is tight.
cards.short_summary: A Wade Hampton Boulevard Taco Bell with official drive-thru service listed as late as 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this location’s drive-thru as open until 2 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday, 3 a.m. Thursday, and 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2031 Wade Hampton Blvd, Greenville
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru closes 2–4 a.m., depending on day; Friday and Saturday are listed to 4 a.m. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Mills Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2 Mills Avenue, Greenville, SC 29605
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a very late food pickup, not the dining room. Consult the official location page before heading over for current service.
cards.short_summary: A Mills Avenue Taco Bell with the latest listed drive-thru hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this location’s drive-thru as open until 4 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 5 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2 Mills Avenue, Greenville
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru 8 a.m.–4 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–5 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Woodruff Road
cards.subtitle: 1770 Woodruff Road, Greenville, SC 29607
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru for an after-hours pickup and allow extra travel time. Review the official daily schedule before departing campus.
cards.short_summary: A Woodruff Road Taco Bell with drive-thru hours listed into the early morning every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this location’s drive-thru as open until 3 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1770 Woodruff Road, Greenville
cards.access_notes: Official listing: drive-thru closes at 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.short_summary: Waffle House location #1168 on Haywood Road is listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official Greenville locator lists Waffle House #1168 at 536 Haywood Road and identifies it as open 24 hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase activities at Furman and in Greenville, with access conditions noted.

cards.title: Music by the Lake
cards.subtitle: Furman Amphitheater, Furman University
cards.notes: Check the summer-series listing, bring a seat or blanket, and listen from the Furman Amphitheater grounds beside the lake.
cards.short_summary: A free public summer concert series on Furman’s lakeside amphitheater grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman states that all Music by the Lake concerts are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Music by the Lake | Furman University
cards.access_notes: Concerts are free and open to the public; confirm the current concert schedule before going.

cards.title: Walk the GCMA galleries
cards.subtitle: 420 College St, Greenville
cards.notes: Visit during public hours, move through the current galleries at your own pace, and follow the museum’s gallery guidelines.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to a downtown art museum with rotating and collection galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenville County Museum of Art states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | Greenville County Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Public hours are Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; check closures before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Thomas and Vivian A. Wong Honor Tower
cards.title: See the view from Honor Tower
cards.subtitle: Unity Park, Greenville
cards.notes: Plan a short observation-deck visit during listed hours; children under 12 need an accompanying adult, and bags are not allowed.
cards.short_summary: A timed, accessible observation-tower visit in Unity Park.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitGreenvilleSC states that admission to the Thomas and Vivian A. Wong Honor Tower is free.
cards.source_title: Thomas and Vivian A. Wong Honor Tower at Unity Park
cards.access_notes: Visits are limited to 30 minutes; listed hours are Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.

cards.entity_name: The Galleries at First Presbyterian Church
cards.title: Browse the church galleries
cards.subtitle: 200 W Washington St, Greenville
cards.notes: Use scheduled gallery hours to view rotating work across three levels, including the Lenz Gallery on the third floor.
cards.short_summary: Free public art viewing in a downtown church’s three-level gallery spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitGreenvilleSC states that admission is free and open to the public during scheduled hours.
cards.source_title: The Galleries at First Presbyterian Church
cards.access_notes: Listed gallery hours are Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Settle in with library Wi-Fi
cards.subtitle: Heritage Green, downtown Greenville
cards.notes: Bring a device, connect to the library’s wireless network, and use the main branch’s indoor spaces or front lawn coverage.
cards.short_summary: Free Wi-Fi at Greenville County’s main library, including its Heritage Green lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all library locations, including the lawn in front of Hughes Main Library.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Wi-Fi hours are listed as Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m., Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sun 1–6 p.m. at Main.

cards.title: Use Wi-Fi at Berea Branch
cards.subtitle: Berea, Greenville County
cards.notes: Meet with classmates or read independently using your own device, then connect to gclswireless and accept the network terms.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood library stop with systemwide free wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m. and Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Connect at Five Forks Branch
cards.subtitle: Five Forks, Greenville County
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or phone, connect to the library wireless network, and choose a quiet table for a no-purchase study or catch-up session.
cards.short_summary: Free system Wi-Fi at a Greenville County Library branch.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m., Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sun 1–6 p.m. at Main and Five Forks.

cards.title: Make a free library stop
cards.subtitle: Pelham Road, Greenville
cards.notes: Bring a device and connect to gclswireless for a low-key work session; no purchase is required to use the wireless network.
cards.short_summary: A Pelham Road library hang centered on free wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.

cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m. and Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Log on at Taylors Branch
cards.subtitle: Taylors, Greenville County
cards.notes: Use the library’s wireless connection for reading, planning, or a shared work session, and keep the visit within branch operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A Taylors branch visit with free county-library Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.

cards.subtitle: Greer, Greenville County

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Furman customs, ceremonies, and recurring campus events—from first-year orientation to Homecoming and finals.

cards.title: LDOC Senior Splash
cards.subtitle: Last Day of Classes • Furman fountain
cards.notes: If you are a graduating senior, check university guidance for the year’s LDOC plans and observe the fountain celebration from an appropriate public area.
cards.short_summary: Graduating seniors mark the last day of classes with a fountain splash.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman identifies seniors splashing in the fountain on LDOC as a tradition; its account describes it as a senior rite of passage.
cards.source_title: 200 Things We Love About Furman
cards.access_notes: Annual timing and participation guidance may vary; consult current university communications.

cards.title: Listen for “FU All the Time”
cards.subtitle: Furman athletics
cards.notes: At a game, follow the cheerleaders and event staff for the appropriate time to join the school cheer; keep the focus on positive, respectful support.
cards.short_summary: A Furman cheer associated with former president John E. Johns.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman lists the “FU All the Time” cheer as having been made famous by former president John E. Johns, who often led it during third quarters of games.
cards.source_title: 200 Things We Love About Furman
cards.access_notes: Occurs in the context of athletic events; check the current game schedule and venue policies.

cards.title: Homecoming Carnival on the Mall
cards.subtitle: Homecoming • Furman Mall
cards.notes: Check the published Homecoming schedule before going; the official tradition page describes carnival activities on Furman Mall during the weekend.
cards.short_summary: An annual Homecoming carnival with rides and activities on Furman Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman describes its Homecoming carnival as an annual event on Furman Mall, with food, rides, and a bouncy castle.
cards.source_title: Spirited Traditions | Furman Homecoming
cards.access_notes: Event details and admission terms vary by year; consult the current Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Build a Homecoming Float
cards.subtitle: Homecoming • Furman Mall
cards.notes: If your organization participates, confirm its plans and work during the scheduled Mall session; the winners are announced at Saturday halftime.
cards.short_summary: A campuswide Homecoming float contest presented by FUSAB.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman’s Homecoming page calls float building a campuswide tradition, presented by FUSAB, with winners announced at halftime on Saturday.
cards.source_title: Spirited Traditions | Furman Homecoming
cards.access_notes: Scheduling and organization participation vary by year; verify the current Homecoming program.

cards.title: Homecoming Bonfire and Pep Rally
cards.subtitle: Homecoming • Milford Mall
cards.notes: Use the current Homecoming schedule for location and timing, and follow all event-staff directions around the bonfire and pep-rally area.
cards.short_summary: A Furman Homecoming tradition led with cheerleaders and team captains.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman’s Homecoming page identifies the pep rally and bonfire as a tradition, led by Furman cheerleaders with appearances by the football team captains.
cards.source_title: Spirited Traditions | Furman Homecoming
cards.access_notes: Event schedule and site controls vary by year; follow on-site safety instructions.

cards.title: Moonlight Breakfast Before Finals
cards.subtitle: End of each semester
cards.notes: Look for the dining announcement near finals; the university describes faculty and staff serving the breakfast event at each semester’s end.
cards.short_summary: Faculty and staff serve a late-semester breakfast event for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman states that Moonlight Breakfast occurs at the end of each semester and is served by faculty and staff to help students prepare for finals.
cards.source_title: Moonlight Breakfast? Yes, please!
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current semester’s dining announcement, location, and eligibility before attending.

cards.title: Start With the First-Year Walk
cards.subtitle: Orientation • PAC to McAlister Auditorium
cards.notes: Incoming students should follow the orientation schedule and staff directions for the procession from the PAC to McAlister Auditorium.
cards.short_summary: First-years walk to Opening Convocation at the start of their Furman experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman’s admissions blog describes incoming students walking from the PAC to McAlister Auditorium for commencement/convocation, with the route echoed at graduation.
cards.source_title: Connecting on Campus: Furman Traditions
cards.access_notes: Available to the entering class when included in the current orientation program.

cards.title: Return Along Furman Mall at Commencement
cards.subtitle: Commencement • McAlister Auditorium to the PAC
cards.notes: Graduating students should rely on the current Commencement instructions for procession order, regalia, staging, guest access, and weather updates.
cards.short_summary: Graduates retrace the first-year route in academic regalia.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman describes graduates walking in regalia from McAlister Auditorium back along the same Mall route used by incoming students.
cards.source_title: Connecting on Campus: Furman Traditions
cards.access_notes: Restricted to the official Commencement procession; consult current Commencement materials.

cards.title: Orientation Singing at South Housing
cards.subtitle: Orientation • SOHO (South Housing)
cards.notes: If scheduled during orientation, follow Orientation Staff direction and residence-hall policies; treat it as a supervised welcome-week activity.
cards.short_summary: A welcome-week singing custom staged below South Housing balconies.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman’s admissions blog reports that Orientation Staff have organized first-years to sing to South Housing balconies during orientation week.
cards.source_title: Connecting on Campus: Furman Traditions
cards.access_notes: This is orientation-program dependent; do not enter residence halls or disturb residents outside official programming.

cards.title: See “Good Luck, Charlie” During Exams
cards.subtitle: Charlie Peace bust • James B. Duke Library
cards.notes: During exams, look for the library’s designated adornments rather than bringing objects yourself; respect library staff, displays, and quiet-study rules.
cards.short_summary: The Charlie Peace bust is dressed up as an exam-time good-luck custom.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman reports that during exam periods the bust of Charlie Peace in the library is adorned for good luck, with a basket of items now used for the tradition.
cards.source_title: Fact or Folklore?: Furman’s Urban Legends
cards.access_notes: Observe library procedures and any staff instructions for the display during exam periods.
